subject.title: Feature request: Self-hosting without a Cloudflare dependency

question: Should ClawRouter permanently support a production-grade non-Cloudflare runtime, and if so, which infrastructure and operational guarantees belong inside the supported contract?
rationale: The requested path changes the deployment, support, durability, identity, and enforcement model across the product; repository evidence cannot determine that permanent support commitment without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Cloudflare-native for now
options.body: Document Cloudflare as the supported production runtime and revisit portability only when a maintainer sponsors a concrete runtime contract.

options.title: Sponsor a portable runtime
options.body: Define infrastructure adapter contracts and conformance tests before accepting a Docker or other self-hosted implementation.

options.title: Support development only
options.body: Provide a clearly unsupported local development harness while retaining Cloudflare as the only production deployment target.

recommendation.title: Keep Cloudflare-native for now
recommendation.body: Document Cloudflare as the supported production runtime and revisit portability only when a maintainer sponsors a concrete runtime contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The initial runtime architecture and Cloudflare service boundaries originate in their gateway work, making them the strongest available owner for framing the architectural choice.
